_meta.purpose: Checks this DEMO build auto-passes because they require verifying something inside an external system this project has no connection to (Fannie Mae's DU/Desktop Underwriter, an internal lender screen called EPIC, or Fannie Mae's Loan Delivery/ULDD system) -- distinct from demo_exclusions.json, which drops checks entirely. These checks are COMPILED and produce a real PASS verdict in the output, indistinguishable from an independently-verified PASS.
_meta.decision: Gordon (2026-07-31): 'for all rules related to DU... we should just PASS them, since we cannot call into the DU system to verify, we will simulate they pass.' Scope confirmed to extend to EPIC and Loan Delivery/ULDD (same root cause), and confirmed the output should show identical to a real PASS (not a distinctly-marked assumed-pass).
_meta.acknowledged_tradeoff: This is a deliberate, documented departure from this project's 'never show a false clean' discipline (see CLAUDE.md, memory silent-false-negative-is-the-worst-failure) -- scoped explicitly to this demo build, not a general project policy. Revisit if the demo's audience or purpose changes.

_meta.extension_2026-08-01_du_relief_precondit: Gordon (2026-08-01), asked directly: should the same "can't verify DU, so simulate pass" tradeoff extend from checks THEMSELVES to PRECONDITIONS that gate other checks' applicability? Decision: yes, extend. Scope: 7 cards (PC::O-FNM-14387/14388/14389/14390/14391/14797, PC::O-FNM-15351) whose applicability.context_flags name one of DU_INCOME_RELIEF_RECEIVED / DU_EMPLOYMENT_RELIEF_RECEIVED / DU_ASSET_RELIEF_RECEIVED / DU_APPRAISED_VALUE_RELIEF_RECEIVED / DU_RENT_PAYMENT_HISTORY_CREDIT_RISK -- facts about what happened inside DU during underwriting, exactly as unverifiable as the process-level DU facts already on this list. Neither converter has these 5 flags in its CONTEXT_FLAG_APPLIES_IF_FIELD/CONTEXT_FLAG_FACT_KEYS map, so today these 7 cards fall through to "unhandled flag, preserve structural verdict" -- i.e. they already resolve APPLICABLE (their only structural condition is Loans.QC_Policy == "Fannie Mae", true for this loan) and proceed into normal check evaluation with no real data to resolve them, landing NEEDS_REVIEW/NO_DATA rather than the intended autopass. Fix is additive only, no code change required: adding these (card_id, exception_code) pairs to this list makes the existing autopass mechanism fire for them exactly as it already does for the other 75 -- _make_autopass_check (p0) / the shape-level autopass link (src) both key off (card_id, exception_code) regardless of *why* the applicability precondition is unresolvable, and autopass is only reached after applicability resolves APPLICABLE (see evaluate_applicability/_evaluate_structural_applicability in run_gold_ruleset_audit.py -- NOT_APPLICABLE/UNKNOWN structural verdicts short-circuit before reaching the autopass check), so this correctly still respects a genuine NOT_APPLICABLE (e.g. a non-Fannie-Mae loan) rather than blindly passing. Of the 50 total exception codes under these 7 cards, 23 were already present in this list (caught earlier by the du_not_accessible/epic_not_accessible verbatim-text regex, since their own description text happens to mention DU/EPIC directly) -- only the 27 that were NOT already covered are added here, tagged with a distinct reason (du_relief_precondition_not_accessible) so an audit of NOT_COMPILED/PASS reasons can still tell a precondition-driven autopass from a check-content-driven one. New total: 75 + 27 = 102.
